# Design 9 distinct hairpins, each folds to (((.(((((((...))))..)))))) 
# pairs: (0,25)(1,24)(2,23)(4,22)(5,21)(6,20)(7,17)(8,16)(9,15)(10,14)
# unpaired: 3,11,12,13,18,19
import random
random.seed(1)

pairs=[(0,25),(1,24),(2,23),(4,22),(5,21),(6,20),(7,17),(8,16),(9,15),(10,14)]
comp={'A':'U','U':'A','C':'G','G':'C'}

def make_hp(stem5):
    # stem5: 10 chars for positions [0,1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10]
    seq=[None]*26
    s5=stem5
    pos5=[0,1,2,4,5,6,7,8,9,10]
    for p,c in zip(pos5,s5):
        seq[p]=c
    # 3' side complements (reverse order along pairs)
    # pair (0,25): seq[25]=comp[seq[0]]; (1,24); (2,23); (4,22);(5,21);(6,20);(7,17);(8,16);(9,15);(10,14)
    for (a,b) in pairs:
        seq[b]=comp[seq[a]]
    seq[3]='A'; seq[11]='A'; seq[12]='A'; seq[13]='A'; seq[18]='A'; seq[19]='A'
    return ''.join(seq)

# distinct 5' stems
stems=[
 'GCGCGCGCGC',
 'CGCGCGCGCG',
 'GCGAGCGAGC',
 'CGAGCGAGCG',
 'GCGUGCGUGC',
 'CGUGCGUGCG',
 'GAGCGAGCGC',
 'CAGGCAGGCA',
 'GGCGGCGGCG',
]
for s in stems:
    hp=make_hp(s)
    print(hp, len(hp))
EOF
